file_id: Bapanapalli Siva Koti Narayana Siva ... vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 2 January, 2020

sentences.text: Bapanapalli Siva Koti Narayana Siva ... vs The State Of Andhra

Author: C. Praveen Kumar
Bench: C. Praveen Kumar
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice C. Praveen Kumar
 Crl.P. No. 6684 of 2019
O R D E R:

-
This Criminal Petition is filed seeking quashing of the proceedings in Crime No. 137 of 2019 of Pedakurapadu Police Station, Guntur District registered for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328 and 420 IPC and Sections 58, 59 and 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act.

The learned counsel for petitioners - A2 and A3 submits that the issue involved in the present case is squarely covered by the Common Order dated 27.08.2018 passed by this Court in Crl.P.No. 3731 of 2018 and batch, which were allowed.

In view of the above submission and following the Common Order dated 27.08.2018 in Crl.P.No.
3731 of 2018 and batch, the present Criminal Petition is allowed in terms thereof.
As a sequel, Miscellaneous Petitions, if any pending, shall stand disposed of as infructuous.
C. PRAVEEN KUMAR, J 02.01.2020 bcj Bapanapalli Siva Koti Narayana Siva ... vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh
